name: roblox-client-mcp
description: Hosted MCP relay that lets an AI inspect and act inside a live Roblox client.

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server ci && npm --prefix web ci
scripts.build: npm --prefix web run build && npm --prefix server run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix server run typecheck && npm --prefix web run typecheck
scripts.test: npm run test:smoke && npm run test:lua
